objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled document managed through the P&R Management system, subject to versioning, approval workflows, and lifecycle management including creation, editing, release, and archiving.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document (Editing, Released, Out of Force)

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which the document is no longer valid

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document, released together with the main document and subject to the same versioning lifecycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the attachment (Editing, Released, Archived)

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information attached to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be deleted independently.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed modification to an existing document created by authorized authors without affecting the document's version history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: An automatically generated request to review and extend the validity period of a document approaching its expiration date.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the document being checked

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to revalidate and restore an archived document to active status.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the document being reactivated

objs.name: user
objs.description: A system user with specific roles and permissions for document management.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned role (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator)

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users grouped for authorization and distribution purposes.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Intended use of the group (e.g., Archive group, Reader group)

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: A step in the document approval or validation process assigned to a user or group.

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: User or group responsible for the task

attributes.name: step_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow step (Creator, Review, Release, Acknowledgement)

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by a workflow participant to confirm their approval of a document or action.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and groups designated to receive documents upon release and optionally required to acknowledge receipt.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a recipient that they have received and reviewed a distributed document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Modification of the document's content through the integrated editing client.

evts.name: edit_metadata
evts.description: Update of document properties, attributes, and metadata through the properties dialog.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read and change permissions to users and user groups for a document.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Addition of supplementary information to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle.

evts.name: sign
evts.description: Application of an electronic signature by a workflow participant to approve or complete a workflow task.

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start of the three-step approval workflow for document release.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal review of document content by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document by designated releasers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a document following successful release, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of a new version when a released document is revised or when certain metadata changes occur.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment for archiving when it is no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a proposed modification to a document without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Integration of a scheduled change proposal into a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Finalization of a change proposal after editing is documented.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatic or manual creation of a request to review and extend document validity 30 days before expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation that a document remains valid and extension of its validity period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of a request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Invalidation of a document, revocation of user authorizations, and archiving for the defined retention period.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of a request to revalidate a previously archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restoration of an archived document to active status with creation of a new version.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatic notification of assigned users and user groups when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic workflow request sent to recipients to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by a recipient that they have acknowledged a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Technical and formal review of translated document content.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Final approval of a translated document version by designated releasers.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document from source format to PDF for web display.

o2o.description: A Document contains one or more controlled Attachments that are released together with the Document.
A Document can have one or more Additional Info items that are managed independently.
A Change Proposal is associated with and modifies a specific Document.
A Validity Extension Request is created for and linked to a Document requiring validity review.
An Override Request is created for a Document that is being invalidated.
A Reactivation Request is created for an archived Document being restored.
A Distribution List defines the recipients and notification method for a Document upon release.
A Document can reference other Documents through content linking or structural relationships.
A User belongs to one or more User Groups that define collective permissions and distribution assignments.
Archived Attachments are linked to new versions when a Document is revised.

o2e.description: A new Document object is created as a result of the Create Document event.
Document content is modified through the Edit Content event.
Document properties and attributes are updated through Edit Metadata event.
Permissions are assigned to Users for a Document through Assign Authorization event.
Permissions are assigned to User Groups for a Document through Assign Authorization event.
An Attachment is created and linked to a Document through Create Attachment event.
Additional Info is created and associated with a Document through Create Additional Info event.
A User applies an Electronic Signature through the Sign event.
A Workflow Task is completed when a User signs through the Sign event.
The release workflow for a Document is started through Initiate Release event.
A User performs technical and formal review of a Document through Review Document event.
A User approves and publishes a Document through Release Document event.
A Document is automatically published following successful Release Document event.
A new version of a Document is created through Create Version event.
An Attachment is marked for archiving through Archive Attachment event.
A Change Proposal is created for a Document through Create Change Proposal event.
A Change Proposal is scheduled for implementation through Implement Change Proposal event.
A Change Proposal is finalized through Complete Change Proposal event.
A Validity Extension Request is created for a Document through Create Validity Extension Request event.
A User confirms extended validity for a Document through Extend Validity event.
An Override Request is created for a Document through Create Override Request event.
A User invalidates and archives a Document through Override Document event.
A Reactivation Request is created by a User through Create Reactivation Request event.
A User restores an archived Document through Reactivate Document event.
Recipients on a Distribution List are notified through Distribute by Email event.
A User receives a workflow request to acknowledge a Document through Request Acknowledgement event.
A User confirms acknowledgement of a Document through Confirm Acknowledgement event.
An Acknowledgement is marked as confirmed through Confirm Acknowledgement event.
A User translates a released Document through Translate Document event.
A User reviews translated Document content through Review Translation event.
A User approves a translated Document version through Release Translation event.
A Document is automatically converted to PDF format through Convert to PDF event.
